text: dsh-markdown-xyy 是面向 DSH Web 对话的 Markdown 主题插件。它在设置页提供主题选择与用户主题编辑，并在运行卡片展示插件版本台账。用户可切换多套内置主题、按系统外观使用浅色或深色样式、创建并保存自定义 CSS 主题，也可查看当前版本及历史记录。主题选择保存在浏览器中，用户主题文件由宿主读写。适合希望调整长对话阅读排版或维护自定义配色的 DSH 用户；无需 API 密钥。

dsh-markdown-xyy themes Markdown in DSH Web conversations. Its settings section lets users switch built-in themes, edit and save custom CSS, and keep their selection in browser storage. A run card shows plugin version history. The host reads and writes user theme files. No API key is needed.
想给 DSH 聊天里的 Markdown 换一套更清晰的配色。
能不能在对话设置里切换浅色和深色主题？
我想给代码块、引用和表格调整阅读样式。
怎样在 DSH 里创建并保存自己的 CSS 主题？
希望主题选择刷新页面后还能保留。
想查看插件当前版本以及以前的版本记录。
I want custom light and dark styling for Markdown in DSH chats.
Can I edit and save my own CSS theme from the settings page?
dsh-markdown-xyy 的功能「主题选择」：用户可从设置页切换内置主题或恢复系统原生样式，选择会保存在浏览器中并在后续页面恢复。
dsh-markdown-xyy 的功能「自定义主题」：用户可在设置界面编辑 CSS；保存前检查语法，再分块交给宿主写入用户主题文件。
dsh-markdown-xyy 的功能「版本台账」：插件运行卡片向宿主登记当前版本并读取历史记录，在卡片中呈现版本信息。

dsh-markdown-xyy README · 📖 项目缘起：做这个项目的初衷很简单：**原生对话样式在面对大量文本时，并不适合阅读。**

大段对话内容堆在一起时，信息是「平」的——标题、引述、重点、代码全靠默认排版撑着，看得越快越抓不住重点。而我每天都要面对大量对话文本，**把重点信息着色、层次分明**就变得特别重要：扫一眼就能定位关键内容，长对话也能快速读完。

这个项目就是为此而来：给对话里的 Markdown 加一套「阅读辅助」主题——重点突出、排版清晰、深浅双档，同时绝不破坏产品默认主题。

> 本项目由 AI 全程协作完成：核心开发是我的合作伙伴 **deepseek-v4-flash**，四套主题的配色由国际友人 **Gemini** 协助调色打磨。

dsh-markdown-xyy README · 特性：- **✔️ 4 套内置主题**，每套浅色 / 深色双档，☀️ / 🌙 / 🖥️ 外观三档随系统切换
- **✔️ 主题选择持久化**：选中的主题自动记住（localStorage），刷新、新开页面、重启后原样恢复，多标签页实时同步
- **✔️ 用户主题即放即用**：往 `~/.dsh/web-themes-xyy/`（Windows：`%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\web-themes-xyy\`，即 `C:\Users\<用户名>\.dsh\web-themes-xyy\`）放一个 CSS 文件就是新主题，无需打包、无需升级插件
- **✔️ 实时主题编辑器**：设置页内新建 / 编辑用户主题，语法高亮 + 一键格式化，保存前双端 CSS 校验
- **✔️ 元素级排版增量覆盖**：`:where()` 零优先级，只兜底裸 Markdown 元素，产品显式样式永远优先
- **✔️ 不可变版本台账**：每个迭代 = 一个不可变 Package，run 卡片内即看当前版本与完整历史，可随时回滚
- **✔️ 常驻安装即用即走**：npm registry 一条命令装好（`dsh plugin add dsh-markdown-xyy`），GitHub 备选，进程重启不丢

dsh-markdown-xyy README · dsh-markdown-xyy：A Cordis plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai). It reskins the Markdown rendering in conversations with pure CSS — headings, code blocks, tables, quotes, links, highlights — without touching the product's baseline theme. Every theme ships a light and a dark variant that follow the system appearance.

dsh-markdown-xyy README · 📖 Why this project exists：The reason is simple: **the native conversation styling is not built for reading long walls of text.**

dsh-markdown-xyy README · 📖 Why this project exists：When a lot of conversation text piles up, everything looks "flat" — headings, quotes, key points and code all lean on default typography, and the faster you scan, the easier it is to miss what matters. Since I deal with large amounts of conversation text every day, **coloring the key information and layering the hierarchy** became essential: being able to spot the essentials at a glance makes even the longest conversations readable.

dsh-markdown-xyy README · 📖 Why this project exists：That is exactly what this project does: a "reading-assist" theme for Markdown in conversations — emphasized highlights, clear typography, light/dark variants, and never touching the product's default theme.

> This project was built end-to-end with AI: core development by my partner **deepseek-v4-flash**, with the four themes' palettes refined with help from my international friend **Gemini**.

dsh-markdown-xyy README · Features：- **✔️ 4 built-in themes**, each with light / dark variants; ☀️ / 🌙 / 🖥️ appearance modes follow the system
- **✔️ Persistent theme choice**: your selected theme is remembered (localStorage) and restored after refresh, a fresh page, or a restart — and synced across open tabs in real time
- **✔️ Drop-in user themes**: put a CSS file into `~/.dsh/web-themes-xyy/` (Windows: `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\web-themes-xyy\`) and it becomes a theme — no packaging, no plugin upgrades
- **✔️ Live theme editor**: create / edit user themes in Settings with syntax highlighting, one-click formatting, and double-side CSS validation
- **✔️ Element-level progressive styling**: `:where()` zero-specificity overrides only touch bare Markdown elements; explicit product styles always win
- **✔️ Immutable version ledger**: every iteration is one immutable Package; current version and full history are shown in the run card, rollback anytime
- **✔️ One-command permanent install**: from the npm registry (`dsh plugin add dsh-markdown-xyy`), GitHub as fallback, survives restarts

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-markdown-xyy
```

**Desktop app (DSH Desktop)** — every DSH profile carries its own plugins, and the Desktop uses its own `desktop` profile. Install from the in-app **Plugins** page, or first register the bundled CLI via the app menu (**Manage dsh command → Install**), then run:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-markdown-xyy
```

Restart the Desktop app afterwards. Works on Windows, macOS and Linux.

dsh-markdown-xyy README · 🎨 Custom themes (copy-paste with AI, re-skin in 3 minutes)：- A theme is a three-section CSS: ① light `body {…}` ② dark `body[data-ds-dark-theme] {…}` ③ element overrides `:where()`. See the reference implementation `plugin/assets/themes/strawberry-mocha.css` (fully commented).
- Drop-in: save it as `~/.dsh/web-themes-xyy/<your-name>.css` (Windows: `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\web-themes-xyy\<your-name>.css`), then click "Refresh user themes" in Settings.
- 90% of a re-skin is a handful of key variables (full contract in [docs/variables.md](docs/variables.md)):
  - `--dsw-alias-bg-base` / `--dsw-alias-bg-layer-1` … background & surface layers
  - `--dsw-alias-brand-primary` brand / accent color
  - `--mdvr-accent` theme accent, `--mdvr-link-*` links, `--mdvr-code-*` code, `--hl-*` syntax highlighting
